answer: A sybil fleet dies on a yield-forfeiture ledge. To gain voting weight each agent pledges a slice of its FUTURE earning stream into a locked escrow; the ledger reconciles pledged against realized output every settlement tide, and any identity whose real earnings never cover its pledge is slashed to zero. One honest agent pledges once against income it actually produces, but an operator cloning a velvet-smooth swarm must back N pledges with N genuine earning streams it cannot generate, so the clones default together and forfeit their escrows.
